scope: Only web/components/part-inspector.js edited by this child. Parent owns dossier, pages, governance and actual public acceptance.

inputs.identityFor: pid => stable object/instance ID string, default part:pid
inputs.titleFor: pid => truthful human title (whole/category aggregate/single instance supplied by caller)
inputs.initialRotation: Existing authored initial angle on show/reopen retained

api.returns: canvas, controls, show, tick, hide, fit, expand, closeExpanded, download, dispose
api.controls: Single DOM subtree returned; append after canvas in dossier slot. data-preview-action=fit/spin/expand/download. Includes truthful object title/ID/common-schematic note and status.
api.integration: Caller must hide before replacing dossier DOM, then show(pid), and append canvas+controls on true. show0 hides controls, closes modal and clears clone meshes. Existing return {canvas: iCv, observer injection anchor remains.

design: Same independent WebGLRenderer/camera/clone scene and canvas are moved between inline slot and native dialog; no second renderer and no source-main-scene DOM or camera is supplied.

Comment placeholders restore exact inline canvas/control positions; outer dossier DOM is never replaced by this component. close/Escape retains iRotX/iRotY and spin state; show/reopen initializes authored angle.
fit computes visibleBounds at current pivot rotation, does not reset rotation; resize only refits. Main scene controls are not available inside this component.

Native modal top layer supplies focus trapping. Captured document keydown stops main scene hotkeys; Escape preventDefault/stopPropagation closes only preview. Dialog pointer events stop propagation. Focus restored only when originating control remains connected.
A queued native close event from an older opening is ignored when a new dialog is open, avoiding synchronous close/reopen races.

atlasSnapshot receives strictly own iScene/iCam/iCv/drawing and own clone meshes. SVG metadata.object_id uses identityFor; caption visibly states object title and ID, independent current-view/common-schematic limits. No main atlas-export is invoked.
Download uses own current drawing-buffer pixels at pixel ratio1 plus editable snapshot caption/leader; it is not a new1536 master or CAD file.
Shared warmwhite renderer/lights/drawing applied; normalize:false preserves baseline source material cloned through materialFor. No new product geometry or physical IDs.

resource_ownership.owned: Lazy renderer; independent scene/camera/groups; cloned materials per source; derived edge geometry/material via createAtlasDrawing; viewport ResizeObserver/window resize; canvas/control/modal/style DOM; pointer/click/key listeners; Blob URLs/timers.
resource_ownership.borrowed: Source geometry, original materials, textures and scene environment. Geometry reused in clone Mesh; original material is cloned, not mutated or disposed. Source textures/environment are not disposed.
resource_ownership.replacement: Disposes previous drawing edges/material and clone materials, removes clone meshes, builds fresh drawing; no old-source edge cache accumulation. No-mesh path leaves0clone meshes and hidden controls.
resource_ownership.hide: Stops visible render ticks and drag, closes modal/restores inline controls. It intentionally keeps reusable renderer until final dispose.
resource_ownership.dispose: Idempotent guard. Hides first, disconnects viewport, disposes derived drawing and clone materials, removes all owned listeners/document capture handler, clears/revokes pending Blob URLs, removes dialog/style/control/canvas and disposes renderer.
resource_ownership.limits: Public runtime instrumentation must count actual resource events and source-object preservation; static ownership review and parse do not prove those events.

actual_checks.result: exit0 (twice, after final race fix as well); syntax only, no module evaluation
Existing scene-atlas atlasSnapshot and scene-view bounds/viewport API used; createSceneSVG name does not exist.
Old return anchor retained, no source.geometry.dispose call, own-scene/camera/canvas snapshot arguments, document capture present.

not_verified: No product HTTP, browser, WebGL rendering, server, module execution, unit or browser test run.
Actual enlarged desktop/phone light/dark readability, rotated fit, close/reopen focus/canvas restoration and main-camera/domain isolation require public verification.
Actual own-SVG download metadata/visible caption/pixels, software0mesh/cache transition and resource dispose counts remain pending.
Caller-provided instance identity and title correctness must be independently verified against campus/rack/server/chip selection in parent page integration.
No claims of source-ready overall TA29, accepted or published. No source/governance/BOM/queue/PR/research/service writes outside the one assigned file.

Owner also identified a source-derived fit boundary: after fitting current rotated AABB, long asymmetric whole scenes may drift toward edges during continued auto-spin. No executed failure; actual public different-yaw/bounded-bounds and long whole-scene rotation checks remain required. Pixel ratio1 is retained; actual buffer dimensions must be recorded rather than infer DPR2.
